settings.heading: The Arc system
settings.body: Choose Compact for a smaller room, Generous for a little more space, or Chaise for stretching out. All three share the same low silhouette and softly tailored cushions.

settings.heading:
A closer look.
A softer edge.
settings.body: Individually crowned cushions meet a fine welt, with softened transitions rather than sharp box edges. Below, separate walnut rails and inset feet give the frame a lighter profile. Explore the construction up close, then compare the three fabrics in the configurator.
